text.en: Several pet owners praise the staff for taking extra steps, such as transporting an ill boarding puppy to a local veterinarian and providing daily photo updates. In contrast, critical reviewers report unaddressed communication lapses and an employee adding a tip without consent.

title.en: Attentive boarding care with isolated neglect

text.en: Most clients report that their dogs enjoyed safe, comfortable boarding stays and received diligent medical and personal attention. However, one long-term patron observed inadequate water provision and found their pet distressed without supervision during a recent stay.

Visitors highlight the modern and tidy environment, pointing to spotless dog boarding suites and well-maintained daycare areas. Pet parents consider the facility a convenient destination for overnight stays, grooming appointments, and daytime play sessions.

q.en: Do staff provide photo updates while dogs are boarded?

a.en: Yes, customers mention receiving daily pictures and progress reports while their pets stay at the facility.

q.en: How do attendants handle sudden medical needs during boarding?

a.en: Reviewers note staff transported a sick puppy to an outside veterinarian and administered prescribed medications.

q.en: Are daycare and grooming services offered together?

a.en: Yes, patrons describe booking daycare, grooming baths, and boarding under the same roof.
